snip.t: Dyspnoea: Onset (acute/gradual), progression, severity (NYHA class if chronic), positional (orthopnoea, paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea - PND).
Exertional dyspnoea, orthopnoea, and paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea indicate acute heart failure secondary to loss of atrial kick and shortened diastolic filling time.
Cardiac (not renal) clues: finger clubbing, palpitations, dizziness/syncope, angina, splinter haemorrhages, paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea.
